reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message: "Thanks, Tobias, noted. Heads up for everyone in #central-team: expense reports are due this Friday (Oct 16)."

He only posted a reminder and didn't ask for anything, so I didn't do anything else. I got Oct 16 by counting forward from the simulation date (Wednesday, Oct 14) and didn't check it against any calendar or policy document.
